messages:
anika: Quick design sync 1: proposing a compact list for prompt-set eval runs with collapsible rows. Goals: keyboard-first, screenreader clarity, and a sane bulk-approve flow. Thoughts?

samir: Compact list + collapsible details seems best. Avoid multi-column grids for SR. Make the row header a <button aria-expanded> and support Up/Down navigation.

jules: Collapse metadata by default (model, run-id, timestamp). Show key metrics (score/status/diff-summary) in the row. Provide a dense toggle for power users.

dina: Accessibility nits: color can be secondary. Use text labels (OK/FL) + icons for status. Ensure contrast at 12px; darken pass green to ~#1f7a32. Add aria-live regions to announce filter/result count changes.

ron: Bulk approve flow: selection -> confirmation sheet. Don't render full provenance for hundreds of items at once. Show condensed list and lazy-load per-item provenance on demand. Modal must trap focus, Esc to dismiss, and announce progress (e.g., "Loaded 20 of 120").

audit-bot: audit: bulk-approve events will log approver, timestamp, and optional comment per item.

anika: Diffs: current inline add/del tags cause layout shift. Proposal: overlay highlights with absolutely positioned spans and tabindex=0 on diff tokens so SR can read change type. Also include a summary line like "2 additions, 1 removal" at top of expanded details.

samir: If tokens are focusable, make the focus outline high-contrast and ensure prefers-reduced-motion is respected for any highlight animation.

jules: Copy choices: single-row CTA = "Approve", bulk CTA = "Approve selected". Tooltip on approve: "Records reviewer and timestamp (auditable)" with aria-describedby.

dina: Keyboard shortcuts: F to focus filters, A to toggle select-all. When selection changes announce via aria-live. Provide Home/End and Left/Right collapse per WAI-ARIA authoring practices.

anika: I'll update Figma and handoff notes: compact rows + collapsed metadata, overlay diffs, lazy provenance in a11y-friendly modal, dense toggle, reduced-motion variants. Please react :thumbsup: to proceed or :eyes: if you want another review.

ron: :thumbsup:
